decision: Computed the boundary of the land Pima County conveyed for Project Blue from the metes-and-bounds legal description in Attachment 2, Exhibit A of the County Administrator's 24 December 2025 memorandum 'Update on Closing on the Land Sale for Project Blue' (portion of the parcel in Docket 6561 at page 1012, south half of Section 11, T16S R15E, Gila and Salt River Meridian; 287.828 acres stated), tied to the BLM CadNSDI positions of the west quarter corner and south-west corner of Section 11, and selected its area centroid as the campus locator replacing the imported Tucson city point.

facts.commencing_corner: West quarter corner of Section 11, T16S R15E, G&SRM (BLM CadNSDI PLSSID AZ140160S0150E0, section 11 polygon vertex -110.7909994, 32.0558745; the same vertex is a corner of the section 10 polygon and the junction of the SWNW and NWSW aliquot parts in the intersected layer)
facts.basis_of_bearings: the description bears the west line of the section from the west quarter corner to the south-west corner S 00 42 37 E, 2628.64 ft; the BLM line from the west quarter corner to the section 11 south-west corner vertex (-110.7910143, 32.0486571; also a vertex of sections 10 and 14) has azimuth 180.1001 deg and length 2625.74 ft in a local transverse Mercator at the corner, so the deed traverse is rotated by +0.8104 deg
traverse: from the west quarter corner N 89 33 01 E 75.00 ft along the east-west mid-section line to the east right-of-way of Harrison Road (point of beginning)
S 00 42 37 E 2553.76 ft along the east right-of-way of Harrison Road to the north right-of-way of Brekke Road
N 89 38 28 E 5085.00 ft along the north right-of-way of Brekke Road to the west right-of-way of Houghton Road
N 00 22 58 W 808.62 ft along the west right-of-way of Houghton Road to the beginning of a tangent curve
curve to the left, radius 1784.86 ft, central angle 35 48 51, arc 1115.67 ft (densified into 24 chords)
reverse curve to the right, radius 2034.86 ft, central angle 22 05 28, arc 784.56 ft (24 chords) to the mid-section line
S 89 33 01 W 4435.45 ft along the mid-section line to the point of beginning
facts.feet: international foot (0.3048 m); the US survey foot differs by 2 parts per million
facts.county_stated_parcel_acres: approximately 290.31 acres (Acquisition Agreement recitals); the County FAQ says a 290-acre parcel
facts.datum: BLM CadNSDI coordinates as returned with outSR=4326 from the NAD83 service; the computation projects them to a local transverse Mercator (GRS80) at the corner and back without a NAD83 to WGS84 shift (about 1 m, not modelled)
facts.verification_script: cogo.py with blue.json (pyproj 3.7.1, shapely 2.1.1; uv run --no-project, python -I)

exclusions: The surveyor's name and contact details on the exhibit are not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport, city centre or employment-centre centroid is used; the Southeast Employment and Logistics Center as a whole is not the locator.
